hypothesis: Independent typed replay is smaller than native journal readback in a bounded, synthetic node-event prefix; fixed policy hashing is measurable but may be too small to justify a production change.
falsifiers: Total replay time approaches or exceeds native readback time
Isolated fixed policy hashing accounts for a material share of the measured replay
scope: One synthetic native Journal prefix under its original ten-second action cutoff. Pure-data calibration is outside that action and cannot establish production or full-chain acceptance.
